method: Versioned append-only application of the D2-04 blind-audit adjudications. Original waveC labels are NEVER rewritten; each record references the adjudication it applies and the original value it supersedes (supersede-point) or the omission it fills (add-visible). Only auditor-upheld adjudications become corrections; resolved-to-waveC, downgraded, partial, and unresolved adjudications are recorded as no-change dispositions.
